name: Heal Rapidly
tagline: A new liquid band-aid promoting a healthier, infection-free healing process
description: Heal Rapidly is developing a revolutionary liquid bandage technology designed to accelerate recovery and prevent infections. The product is market-ready with completed safety and stability studies, positioning it for FDA approval. Founded by a veteran research scientist with 27 pharmaceutical patents, the company aims to disrupt the traditional wound care market with a more effective, easy-to-apply solution.

founders.name: Thomas Konowalchuk
founders.bio: Research scientist, MD, and Attorney with 20+ years of medical research experience. Holds 27 pharmaceutical patents and has founded multiple biotech ventures.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Heal Rapidly officially launched its Wefunder campaign to fund FDA approval and initial production runs.

highlights: Product ready for FDA approval phase

name: Sonical
tagline: Everyone hears better: using AI to turn headphones into smart devices
description: Sonical is building CosmOS, an operating system for the ear that transforms standard headphones into powerful smart devices. By utilizing AI and low-latency processing, Sonical enables personalized hearing health, wellness monitoring, and advanced audio experiences. The company is backed by strategic investors and over 100 technology developers currently building on their platform.

founders.name: Dr. Gary Spittle
founders.bio: PhD in binaural hearing with 30+ years of experience in audio product development. Expert in silicon, software, and system architecture.

updates.title: Developer Ecosystem Growth
updates.body: Now over 100 developers are actively utilizing CosmOS to create next-generation hearing applications.

highlights: Targeting the multi-billion dollar hearables market
Led by PhD audio expert with 30 years experience

name: CAREVERSE AI
tagline: Search, compare, and get care anywhere
description: CAREVERSE AI, powered by Care Access PBC, is a global healthcare navigation platform that uses artificial intelligence to simplify the patient journey. The platform allows users to find, compare, and schedule healthcare services globally without the need for traditional insurance. By consolidating care options into one interface, CAREVERSE aims to lower costs and increase accessibility in a $25 trillion market.

founders.name: Alex Shchekin
founders.bio: Entrepreneur with a background in logistics, tech, and media innovation. Focused on solving complex healthcare infrastructure challenges through AI.

updates.title: Early Bird Funding Active
updates.body: Campaign launched with active early-bird terms to accelerate the development of the AI care coordination engine.

highlights: Multilingual support for international health travel

name: Gesture
tagline: Simplifying how people send & receive tangible gifts in realtime
description: Gesture is a mobile platform designed to make gifting as easy as sending a text message. By removing the need for a recipient's physical address, Gesture allows users to send flowers, wine, and other tangible gifts instantly using only a phone number or social handle. The company operates a lean, high-efficiency model and previously raised $1.5M to scale its logistics and delivery network.

founders.name: Ben Labra
founders.bio: 20+ years of experience across ops, tech, and law. Columbia Business School alumnus with a previous successful soft exit.

updates.title: Logistics Expansion
updates.body: Gesture expanded its delivery network to include more real-time gift categories in the New York tri-state area.

highlights: Minority-founded with a lean operating model
High seasonal ROI during gifting holidays

name: RACE CAR MONKS The Movie
tagline: To save the monastery they must take the checkered flag
description: RACE CAR MONKS is a feature film project currently in pre-production. The story follows a group of monks who enter a high-stakes auto race to save their monastery from financial ruin. The project is led by an Emmy-winning producer and a veteran film team with a combined century of industry experience, focusing on high-quality family and faith-based entertainment with strong commercial potential.

founders.name: Brian Shields
founders.bio: Experienced filmmaker whose credits include the Emmy Award-winning series 'From the Earth to the Moon.' Specializes in independent films with high per-theater revenue.

updates.title: Pre-Production Goal Met
updates.body: The campaign has successfully raised the necessary funds to begin full pre-production and casting.

highlights: Strong historical performance in faith-based genre
Combined 100+ years of film industry team experience
